items.text: On behalf of the Key Club, we would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in our recent Blood Drive! Thanks to your generosity, we collected 67 blood donations, with the potential to save up to 200 lives! Thank you for making a difference and helping save lives!

The Performing Arts Department is proud to present the hit musical comedy Rock of Ages on Friday, November 20, and Saturday, November 21, at 7:00 PM in the South Middle School Auditorium! To purchase tickets, scan the QR code on posters displayed throughout the school or contact Drama Director Ms. Ilana Meredith for more information. Tickets are $10 for students. Don't miss this exciting performance!

Seniors applying to a college with a deadline of November 18, MUST submit their College Transcript Release Form to their guidance counselor by Friday, October 9th. Forms can be found in your guidance counselor’s Google Classroom.
